# Dr Clutter — Junk Removal, Lehigh Valley & Berks County, PA

> Family-run junk removal and cleanout company serving Allentown, Bethlehem, Easton, Kutztown and the greater Lehigh Valley, Pennsylvania since 2011. Owned and operated by Scott Clark. Slogan: "Got junk? Call the Doctor — we make house calls." Pay for the truck space you use, not for time.

## Key facts
- Business: Dr Clutter (Dr. Clutter Junk Removal)
- Owner: Scott Clark, Pennsylvania native, founded 2011
- Phone / text: (610) 393-0024 (text a photo of your junk for a firm quote in minutes)
- Email: drclutter@icloud.com
- Address: 299 Wynview Rd, Kutztown, PA 19530
- Hours: 7 days a week, 7 AM – 9 PM; same-day service available
- Licensed and insured for residential and commercial work across Pennsylvania
- Truck: 16-ft box truck — about 60% more capacity than the typical 10-ft franchise truck
- Same-day guarantee: book before noon, junk gone by 6 PM the same day, or $50 off
- Walk-away pricing: free on-site estimate; if you don't like the price, you pay nothing

## Pricing (by truck space used, not time; free estimates)
- 1/10 truck (a few items): from $150
- 2/10 truck (a room corner): from $250
- 1/2 truck (garage or full room): from $550
- Full 16-ft truck (whole-house / estate): from $1,050
- Hot tub removal & haul-away: from $550
- Full estate cleanout (3-bedroom home): from $1,495
- Multi-truck jobs: 10% off each additional truck
- Surcharges: mattresses, tires, paint cans
- All prices include labor, loading, hauling, disposal fees and a broom-sweep finish

## Services
Junk removal; furniture and appliance removal; mattress removal; estate cleanouts; eviction and foreclosure cleanouts; garage, basement and attic cleanouts; hot tub, shed and deck removal (light demolition included); construction debris removal; hoarding cleanup; garage storage installation. Donate-first policy: usable items go to Lehigh Valley charities with tax receipts; metals and electronics recycled; landfill last.

## Why Dr Clutter vs. franchises (1-800-GOT-JUNK, JDog, College Hunks)
Published, honest pricing (text a photo for a firm quote) instead of price-after-the-truck-arrives; a 16-ft truck (~60% more room) so the same fraction-of-a-truck price clears more junk; no franchise royalties or out-of-state call-center overhead; the owner who answers the phone is the person at your door; the same local crew every time. Se habla español.

## Service area
Allentown, Bethlehem, Easton, Kutztown, Emmaus, Macungie, Whitehall, Trexlertown, Breinigsville, Fogelsville, Orefield, Coplay, Hellertown, Center Valley, Northampton, Catasauqua, Nazareth, and Reading (northern Berks County), Pennsylvania.
